title: Unread, History and Favourites
items: A daily verse you missed is no longer lost: it waits in Unread until you open it.
History keeps every verse sent to this device.
Star a verse to keep it in Favourites.
The app icon shows how many verses are unread.

hints.text: Missed a push? It waits here in Unread.
Every past verse, in one place.
Verses you star are kept here.
Tap the star to save a verse to Favourites.
